verdict.rationale: Weave captures the underlying metrics: execution metadata per call, automatic and custom cost tracking shown in the trace tree and calls table, and scorer outputs. It also offers evaluation comparison visualizations, leaderboards and "native analytics tools." However, nothing documents a user-configurable dashboard builder for composing panels over these metrics; the REST API only implies you could build dashboards externally. Missing for 10: explicit custom dashboard creation, latency and error-rate charts or aggregation, cost-over-time panels, combining eval scores with operational metrics in one view, and hands-on corroboration.
